steps.claim: §12.2 says a borrowed entry denotes checked borrow lifetime k, "A borrowed position beyond the checked borrow requirement rejects as ill-formed", "every supplied width MUST equal that component’s width", and omitted components are zero "including omitted borrowed positions after the listed entries". §12.1 fixes tuple borrowed widths by checked lifetimes and forbids omitting unchanged components. K85 includes all borrowed positions among the remaining components that must be full for image-relative proof.

steps.claim: The implementation instead uses domain.borrowed itself as the lifetime inventory. certificate.rs:283-289/324-329 derives tuple count/widths from it; domain_for does not compare borrowed positions/widths with the source. claims.rs::domain determines completeness from interface slots and listed ranges, while execute_element_bound allocates only supplied borrowed components. replay09.rs::coverage sums only their supplied widths.

Reproduced two malformed successes with unchanged invocation args=[] and budget=["0","0","0","0"]. (a) In image-0102.bisa, which has no qborrow and an empty frame.borrow, set domain.borrowed=[{"name":"ghost","width":1,"lo":0,"hi":1}] and expand each original table row into b=0 then b=1, setting before/after.borrowed=[str(b)]. Parse succeeds; verify_claim and verify_certificate return ProofRelativeToImage, n=128, |D|=8388608. (b) In controlled-dirty.bisa change the sole borrowed width from 1 to 2 and hi from 1 to 3, expanding each row over b=0..3. Both APIs again return ProofRelativeToImage, n=512, |D|=33554432. Both inputs must instead reject as ill-formed.

Reproduced the converse narrowing: in controlled-dirty.bisa set domain.borrowed=[] and retain just the b=0 rows, keeping their complete before/after.borrowed=["0"]. Parse rejects with "§12.1 K13: incomplete borrowed tuple". Replacing expected with {"program": the existing subject closure hash} admits the object, but both checkers reject with "§5.6: designated idle set lacks requested borrowed wires". The omitted-at-zero slice is legal and its unchanged relation should give Evidence{elements:128}, unrestricted |D|=16777216 and fraction 1/131072; it must not become image-relative proof.

The same missing checked-lifetime inventory both accepts malformed proof domains and rejects a legal K85 evidence slice. This is S0 parser/claim fidelity, independently of the staged numerical or preparation machinery.

blocking.fix: Add a shared resolver for the subject invocation’s ordered checked borrow lifetimes (including source expansion and distinct repeated lifetimes, not just maximum simultaneous pool capacity). Implement §12.2’s quoted lifetime-position/width rules by rejecting extra positions and width mismatches; implement "Every omitted component is held at zero ... including omitted borrowed positions" by materializing missing borrowed values as zero while retaining every lifetime in the full tuple and unrestricted denominator. summary:
Codex review of a0b49a0646c56955b0e89e126b865965c5a82599 against ISA 0.9 K85. Verdict revise: two witnessed S0 issues, one core and one contract. No prior-round blocker list was supplied for round 1, so previous_status is empty. No new regression attributable to the three-commit diff was established; the underlying borrowed-inventory and host-report paths predate it. The schema has no severity property and disallows additional properties, so each blocker is explicitly marked S0 in section and steps.

Method 1: Derived inc8(8) before execution: the const/add/retval rows take three steps, giving (9,0,3) at B=3; at B=2 only const/add execute and commit gives (0,1,2). Checked B=0..4 with those exact results. Derived the sum_db stack/depth fault: its 13 locations require R=16 cells, so stack=15 or depth=0 faults at the third executed row with (0,3,3), confirmed. Independently constructed/hash-checked the §9.2 input bytes: the LF-terminated inc8 envelope gives ed9865300b85a519c2379de98e36e635e72b5b78d8bdfca03dccf9a09aa3df5e; zero gives 43e032f98d7aff20f6864d6368b20ab4ef9d810938999acff8d71ed16e6b17d7; sum, with its self-reference SCC wrapper, gives cb52102decd586b7585b5d73b90841dcec75edac5a5a2d0f43c5efb34d4cceb1; sum_db gives 3ad937b1cd867454989c5c5f58244681ef2c09dbabf7fce56515a68f63462ee6. Independently reproduced all 30 K85 source/interface/closure/object identities and artifact hashes with Python hashlib; no interpreter output served as the expected oracle for those calculations.

Required K85 reproductions: (i) 0102 unpacks to cells [1,2]; qload/cx/qunload maps t to t XOR (db[a]&1), preserving f,a,db, so t/f/a give 2*16*2=64 rows in ordinal order 32*t+2*f+a. Unrestricted D has 6+16=22 bits; 64/4194304=1/65536. 0201 gives [2,1], reverses the selected low bit and has identical coverage. Independently checked all successful complete vector tables and denominators. (ii) SHA-256(raw 01 02)=a12871fee210fb8619291eaea194581cbd2531e4b23759d225f6806923f63222, whereas raw 02 01 gives 25dfd29c09617dcc9852281c030e5b3037a338a4712a42a21c907f259c6412a0 and ASCII 0102 gives f19ccf1eb395a4d74606c59b491ecd0a37b5f26eae0ec55c33bbd2743c658b26; swapped/text hashes must reject. Packing 1f01 gives 31+(8<<5), while d1 has illegal padding for two three-bit cells. (iii) For U=Z,V=I,J=(1,0)^T, (U-V)J=0 but unrestricted Frobenius norm squared is 4. Reduced input dimension 1 and complete output dimension 2 require a 2x2 Choi difference. Y=I2/8 has two positive 1/8 pivots and mu=3/8 leaves partial-trace slack 1/8. For -I/I the restricted difference is (-2,0), squared norm 4, despite equal uncontrolled channels. These results agree with the published independent map vector. The controlled dirty pair cancels exactly; the one-bit image [1,0] yields t XOR (control AND NOT a), explaining the independent inverse and Bell-reference restoration test.

Method 2: Traced complete §3.6 pc/successor/fault cleanup and §3.7 C5^-1,C4^-1,C3^-1,C2^-1,C1^-1 and R5^-1,R4^-1,R3^-1,R2^-1,R1^-1. At sum_db's first call the return index is 3, destination id 2, captured base 4096, sp advances 0->16 and depth 0->1. The inverse restores counters before stack addressing and clears captured arguments last. Ret leaves sp=16 and restores depth to 0; its inverse restores callee fp before delivery. Executed each row followed by its inverse and compared complete snapshots. Inc8 prefixes, including idle HALT, restore clean frames. For §7.4, traced and executed nested f/g clock-read segments: reverse ret, effect and call; remove the tape entry; skip prior cancellation marks during the enclosing uncall and whole-run reversal. Clock/tape finish at zero and the complete entry snapshot is restored.

Method 3: Reviewed SPEC-QUESTIONS 1-33 as historical 0.8 readings against their 0.9 resolutions: row indexing, idle frames, minimum counters, literal/metadata encodings, call tiers, K76/K78 borrow domains, K13 replay, complete qif inversion, measurement order, structured layout paths and bound schedule contexts. The recorded staged interval/schedule work is not evidence of completed verification. The two blockers need implementation changes under explicit clauses, not a new spec reading.

Method 4: Ran the required todo/unimplemented/unwrap/expect/panic/unreachable/unsupported/assume/approximation scan over src (363 matches). Classified test assertions/helpers separately from production invariant assertions (validated schema variants, nonempty/sized collections, token bindings, Tarjan traversal, persistent buffers), deliberate unknown-version/device rejection and diagnostic-only amplitude approximations. No todo!/unimplemented! stub or new panic witness was found. The demonstrated failure is typed HostResource propagation, not a guessed panic.

Method 5: Compared the §4.1/4.2 row families, §5.4 codes 0-10, §3.6 frame slots, §7.4 history operations, K85 domain/label/report fields and the documented CLI command surface with their dispatch/schema paths. Fixed regions, packing, requested labels and signature-order mem:N reports are present; checked borrowed positions and K75 per-claim outcome handling expose the discrepancies above. The broader 0.9 migration and target/schedule/launch/numerical machinery remain expressly staged; this review does not claim a new exhaustive whole-ISA conformance result.

Validation: 22 reference integration tests passed (isa09_fixed_image:7, isa09_claim_replay:9, isa09_certificate:6); six conformance tests passed (ref_k85:2, case_data:4). Additional read-only/in-memory probes reproduced both blockers and the budget/reversal checks. Direct and certificate numerical/channel probes returned Unverified with the rigorous-checker reason, and scheduled replay tests remained Unverified with no coverage. Preparation/native verification has no implemented acceptance path: only the conditional image theorem is returned, with the reporting improvement suggested above. The restricted-map fixture is independent arithmetic evidence, not an executable process certificate. No full orchestrator gate was run or claimed. All builds/probes used the requested private TMPDIR/CARGO_TARGET_DIR with DISPLAY, WAYLAND_DISPLAY, DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS and BROWSER unset. No tracked repository file, commit or bd state was changed.
